title: In situ ligand formation in the synthesis of an octanuclear dysprosium ‘double cubane’ cluster displaying single molecule magnet features

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, (Me4N)(dcnm) (50 mg, 297 µmol) dissolved in methanol (1 mL) was added to DyCl3·6H2O (41 mg, 109 µmol) dissolved in methanol (4 mL). Triethylamine (100 µL) was added and the solution was allowed to stand, affording light yellow crystals over one month. The crystalline product was washed with methanol. In situ nucleophilic addition of methanol and residual water to dcnm generates the cmnm and ccnm ligands, promoted by Dy(III).
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Light yellow crystals formed on standing for one month and were washed with methanol.

properties.summary: The Dy8 double-cubane cluster shows χMT behaviour consistent with eight Dy(III) ions and probable SMM features: frequency-dependent out-of-phase ac susceptibility below ~6 K without observable χM″ maxima above 2 K, so an Arrhenius barrier could not be extracted. Magnetisation at 2 K/5 T does not saturate (39 NμB vs 80 NμB expected for eight free Dy ions), consistent with anisotropy/ligand-field effects. No long-range magnetic order is observed.
